line_items.work_text: To develop and deploy low-cost sustainable landslide monitoring solutions in Mandi District. 20 critical landslide points will be selected along with the major district road between Mandi to Kataula via Katinid.

Geological hazards mitigation using store concrete block retaining walls and helical soil nailing. This would include: developing shake table experimental setup, procurement of locally preparation, fabrication of soil nails, lab testing and dynamic blocks and helical nails, development of field prototype with full instrumentation, manpower and field construction equipment, training and transfer of technology.

narrative: The Governor has sanctioned the diversion of funds from SDRF for various disaster management projects.
